name: frozen-bus-policy-execution-attribution-v1
analysis: Report paired differences for each demand and execution layer; aggregate demands equally within each of six environment blocks before block-level uncertainty estimation. Retain all directions. These are frozen-policy comparisons, not six independent training seeds.
limitations: One existing training seed; actors selected by the largest existing calibrated budget, not new evaluation outcomes.
Offline and hybrid share a 10000-update offline prefix; source has no prefix. Only continuation update counts are matched, not total compute.
The bounded-budget hybrid uses ratio correction; it is not the unit-weight actor in the original formal completion-guard experiment.
Fixed-horizon passenger cost includes accrued costs of unfinished passengers, not their full remaining journeys.
The common layer scales proposed holds by 0.25 and applies the existing headway reserve. Native rule references bypass these transformations and are outside the execution-factor comparison.
